description: GENERIC PLAN.md section template — customizable seed transplanted by transplant-bundle (git-worktree-isolation) to external projects. brief2dev itself does not read this JSON (Option C — live path uses fixed JS constant .claude/scripts/lib/worktree-plan-template.mjs#DEFAULT_PLAN_SECTIONS). The `sections` array follows the schema of .cli/lib/section-template-renderer.mjs#renderTemplateFromSections (5 block types: static/checklist_group/field_list/fenced_block/table, {{var}} placeholders). Deep-equal to DEFAULT_PLAN_SECTIONS (pinned by drift regression test in tests/unit/worktree-plan-template.test.mjs) — target projects can customize headings, sections, and checklist items post-transplant while renderer contract remains intact.

lines: (Required — Single sentence describing the objective achieved in this worktree)
(Required — Why is this change necessary now? Existing gaps/issues)

sections.heading: ## Acceptance (Frozen at kickoff — record rationale in Decisions if modified)

lines: (Required — Verifiable acceptance criteria for this worktree to be considered "done". Pre-Ship verdict cross-checks this criteria. Using `- [ ]` checkboxes includes them in ship completion checks)

items: (Required — Automated checks like lint / audit / smoke tests)
(Remove section or mark (dropped) if inapplicable. For UI changes, note verification steps like "Check X in browser")

lines: <!-- Format: - YYYY-MM-DD done: <completed item> / evidence: <file:line · test output · commit sha> / next: <next action> / blocker: <if any> -->
<!-- An "in progress" line without fresh evidence is not a progress report (heartbeat ≠ progress). Do not modify existing entries; append only. -->
- (Required — Distinguish AI default decisions from explicit user decisions)

_adapt.purpose: External project adaptation guide (brief2dev code does not read this key — guidance only).
_adapt.how: Customize heading wording, section count, and checklist_group subheading/items. 5 block types (static/checklist_group/field_list/fenced_block/table) are evaluated by .cli/lib/section-template-renderer.mjs.
_adapt.wiring: This JSON is not automatically loaded by any runtime code. To apply, wire target project worktree-init.mjs to pass `renderPlanTemplate(branch, { createdAt, sections: <this JSON's sections array> })`, or replace DEFAULT_PLAN_SECTIONS in transplanted worktree-plan-template.mjs with this JSON's contents directly.
